answer: Live Rendezvous Requirement. Identities whose attestations count jointly must pass a six-round challenge together, each replying inside a window drawn from its own measured round-trip jitter; keys with correlated timing collapse into one. So an operator buys separate hosting per identity and a session per cooperating pair: 1,000 survivors need ~500,000 sessions per round. Each added puppet stretches that serial queue in a spiral: the hundredth costs about a hundred times the first in wall-clock. The effort drains off like water into karst, never reusable. Idle keys stay frozen, tundra-like.
